scope: Operational calendar adapter and honest failure behavior; does not claim that real runtime official calendar packets are already installed.
implementation: Existing frozen resolveCalendar validates complete declared coverage, version/source/hash/capture known-at, timezone and explicit session close instants. New source-input boundary binds the reviewed calendar normalization to exact authoritative raw capture identity.
separation: Each family requires its own governed packet. Equity close is not VIX publication; CFE settlement is not the equity clock. Release availability remains actual capture bound even with an exact observed session end.

officialSources.title: NYSE Holidays & Trading Hours
officialSources.supports: NYSE Arca core-session hours, 2026 holidays and early closes. Published times are Eastern. The source lists November 27 and December 24, 2026 early closes at 13:00 ET.
officialSources.notProof: No parsed runtime packet or archived provider-publication timestamp was created from this browse.

officialSources.title: Cboe Hours & Holidays — U.S. Futures
officialSources.supports: Separate CFE trading-hours specification in Central Time and a linked 2026 Futures Settlement Calendar.
officialSources.notProof: Trading-hours page is not a substitute for reviewing exact daily settlement schedule/holiday exceptions.

maintenanceWorkflow: Fetch and preserve official raw calendar/settlement sources using existing authorized capture infrastructure outside Git.
Review the complete declared interval, including exceptions and source family. Materialize explicit session and timezone-aware closedAt instants, covering DST and early closes.

Attach id, version, sourceId, sourceVersion, timezone, coverageStart/End, completeIntervalCoverage, capturedAt/availableAt and raw vintage hash. Do not claim the version was known before it was captured.
Record transformVersion plus hash(calendar). Supply this CalendarPacket under the corresponding family in the external source bundle.
Replace an expiring packet only by adding a new version with new raw provenance. Existing snapshots retain their original packet for replay.
If a packet is absent, partial, out of coverage, malformed, from the future, or only an R2 observed-date proxy, let UNKNOWN_CALENDAR make the dependent core unavailable.

fixturePolicy: All test schedule values and raw captures are synthetic OFFICIAL-format fixtures. They are never asserted to be captured exchange data or used as runtime official calendars.
knownLimitations: No official global calendar fetcher or generic weekday algorithm is installed.
VIX, BTC and GLD publication availability cannot be inferred from exchange session clocks.
A reviewable hash proves exact normalization identity, not the correctness or authenticity of an operator's source transcription.
Strict R0 eligibility requires the relevant calendar version to have been available at each original capture; a later calendar revision cannot retroactively prove earlier capture-session mapping.
